units.source_text: 崖上的兴奋，这时也像断了骨子的洋伞，眼见着偃旗息鼓了。

en.t: By now, the excitement up on the cliff had also collapsed, like a Western umbrella with its ribs broken, and was visibly losing all momentum.

units.source_text: 不满、失笑和激励的声援，三者即使一起出声，也已经合不起拍子，捉襟见肘了。

en.t: Dissatisfaction, stifled laughter, and encouraging cheers, even when all three voices rose together, could no longer keep time with one another and had grown awkwardly inadequate.

units.source_text: 夹杂醉意的猥亵骂声，再也成不了推波助澜的补充剂。

en.t: The obscene drunken jeers could no longer serve as fuel to push the commotion along.

units.source_text: 像是有人扔东西下来，立刻有人出来制止。

en.t: It seemed that whenever someone threw something down, someone else immediately came forward to stop it.

units.source_text: 就像开头的唐突那样，结尾也很唐突。

en.t: Just as the beginning had been abrupt, the ending was abrupt as well.

units.source_text: 拖着长长的尾巴，响起了催促干活的吆喝声，灯光排成一列，像被谁拖走了似的，倏忽消失了。

en.t: A drawn-out shout urging people back to work rang out like a long trailing tail, and the lights lined up in a row, then vanished in an instant as though someone had dragged them away.

units.source_text: 此后，只剩下幽暗的北风呼啸，把刚才的喧嚣吹得无影无踪。

en.t: After that, only the dark north wind was left howling, blowing away every trace of the earlier uproar.
